info.name: Gazebo - Stock Recall Genealogy
info.description:
Complaint / recall stock genealogy APIs.

**Tables:** `stock_lot`, `stock_balance`, `stock_unit`, `stock_genealogy`, `stock_entry`.

Look up by **product_id + use_by** when the pack does not identify a single lot; returns every matching batch with balances, units, and backward/forward trees.

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}`, `{{product_id}}`, `{{use_by}}`

query.description: Finished-goods (or any) product id from the pack
Use-by date YYYY-MM-DD printed on the pack

request.description:
### Recall by product + use-by

`GET /stock/recall/?product_id=:id&use_by=:date`

Complaint / glass-in-food flow when staff only have product id and use-by from the pack. Returns **every** `stock_lot` with that pair (different trace numbers / production dates), each with balances, stock units, and full backward + forward genealogy trees. Empty `lots` is success when no batch matches (wrong date).

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product_id` | yes | Product primary key |
| `use_by` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DD` |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message: "Recall report fetched.", data: { product, use_by, lot_count, lots: [ { lot, balances, stock_units, has_genealogy, genealogy: { backward, forward, graph: { nodes, edges } } } ] } }`

Genealogy rows include `lot_id`, `product_id`, `product_name`, `trace_number`, `supplier_lot_code`, `depth`, entry ids, `quantity_base`. `graph` is React Flow–ready (`nodes[].data.role` = focus|upstream|downstream; edges input→output).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success (including zero matching lots) |
| 400 | Missing / invalid `product_id` or `use_by` |
| 404 | Product missing or inactive |

query.description: 1 = include backward/forward trees; 0 = lot index + has_genealogy + edge_count only

request.description:
### Product genealogy index

`GET /stock/products/:product_id/genealogy/?with_trees=1`

Lists all available stock lots for a product (newest first, cap 200) with genealogy flags and optional full trees. Use when browsing every batch for a product without a use-by filter.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product_id` | yes | Product primary key |

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `with_trees` | no | Default `1`. Use `0` / `false` / `no` for a light index (`lot`, `has_genealogy`, `edge_count` only) |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message: "Product genealogy fetched.", data: { product, lot_count, with_trees, lots: [ ... ] } }`

When `with_trees=1`, each lot matches the recall lot shape (balances, stock_units, genealogy) plus `edge_count`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Invalid `with_trees` |
| 404 | Product missing or inactive |

### Trace backward (lot)

`GET /stock/trace/backward/?lot_id=:id`

Low-level lot genealogy: ingredients / supplier lots that fed into this lot (parents).

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lot_id` | yes | Stock lot primary key |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message: "Backward trace fetched.", data: [ { lot_id, product_id, trace_number, supplier_lot_code, depth, input_entry_id, output_entry_id, quantity_base }, ... ] }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success (empty list if no edges) |
| 400 | Missing / invalid `lot_id` |

### Trace forward (lot)

`GET /stock/trace/forward/?lot_id=:id`

Low-level lot genealogy: finished goods / downstream lots this lot fed into (children). Use after identifying a suspect supplier lot from backward trace.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lot_id` | yes | Stock lot primary key |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message: "Forward trace fetched.", data: [ { lot_id, product_id, trace_number, supplier_lot_code, depth, input_entry_id, output_entry_id, quantity_base }, ... ] }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success (empty list if no edges) |
| 400 | Missing / invalid `lot_id` |
